subject: CONVERT function
notes: LANDED 2026-08-09 (PB59 family 5a): BindConvert now walks the 15.19.2 format BY POSITION - slot 0 is ALWAYS argument-1 and binds as an operand, slots 1+ must be format keywords in order. A data item NAMED one of the 8.10 context-sensitive words (NAT/ANUM/HEX/BYTE) is legal as argument-1 and compiles (CONVERT(NAT HEX ANUM) with 01 NAT PIC XX -> A, the CS corpus row); a misplaced operand (CONVERT(ANUM WS-A ANUM HEX), CONVERT(ANUM ANUM HEX WS-A) - both previously ACCEPTED, printing 41) is rejected with COBOL1514 plus the 1639 name-resolution error the operand position now correctly surfaces. The catalog row's MinArgs corrected 2 -> 3 (argument-1 + source-format + destination-format is the format's minimum) alongside BindConvert's own guard.
